desc: Implement cost computation: `cost = ((num + t - 1) // t) * t - num` for each num, target pair.
Build per-target candidate lists: sort by cost, keep top L (e.g., 30), and deduplicate by index.
Implement DFS/backtracking with pruning using a lower bound (sum of min remaining costs) to find minimum total cost assigning each target a distinct candidate.
Handle target length 1, edge cases (already satisfied), and early exit if best cost 0.
Write final `Solution.minimumIncrements` method with the described logic and include necessary imports.
Add quick sanity check on provided examples after implementation.
